name: implement-ui-slice
description: Implement one approved ClipYantra UI component or page slice against the approved design system and screen specification.
---

# Implement UI Slice

Proceed only with an explicit `APPROVE SLICE <ID>`.

Read the exact screen spec, token/component contracts, interaction states, responsive and accessibility rules. Inspect existing components and tests. Implement only the approved slice. Use real API contracts or explicit disabled states; do not invent successful behavior. Add component tests. Capture screenshots at required viewports. Do not touch unrelated design tokens or pages. Report visual deviations and request independent visual QA.
